versions.changelog: 更新 SKILL.md 为官方版本，包含完整的 frontmatter 元数据和技术文档
更新 README.md 为官方版本，优化技能描述和用法说明
飞书自主汇报技能，专为多 Agent 协作设计，零配置自动适配

Initial release of Feishu Send Message skill for multi-agent collaboration:

- Enables agents to send Feishu messages to users or groups with independent robot identities.
- Zero configuration: Agents auto-scan and use skill at startup.
- Supports both private (open_id) and group (chat_id) message sending.
- Credentials automatically read from agent-specific config files.
- Designed for seamless integration in multi-agent task workflows.
